request: Should we add MongoDB alongside Postgres for the user-settings table?
facts: The user-settings table gets about 200 writes a day and holds 30,000 rows.
Postgres runs at about 2% of its capacity and has had no incident tied to this table.
None of the three engineers on the team has run MongoDB in production.
No planned feature is blocked by keeping the table in Postgres.
A second database means a second backup job, a second upgrade path and a second on-call runbook.
note: Affirmative half of a pair. An added system with a carrying cost and no stated need: it should not pass.
